summary: EXP-618 integration (commit-level: decider 2026-06-12) skipped the EXP test_recommendation: no test asserts the new WIN-014/κ-cluster strings. P1 and P3 find-strings are strict prefixes of their replace-strings, so an accidental re-application would silently duplicate paragraphs and 3,827 existing tests would not catch it.
detail: Mode 2b verification of EXP-618 confirmed all 3 patches present exactly once (P1 closure paragraph, P2 tldr punchline, P3 κ-cluster weather-attribution sentence; the second cjg20130306 DOI occurrence in sections.json is a pre-existing independent citation, not double-application). Recommended test additions per EXP-618 test_recommendation: (1) WIN-014.detail_evidence contains 'drastic changes in the weather' exactly once and '4–25×' exactly once; (2) sections.json contains 'progressively disavowed by its own discoverers across three publications' exactly once. Count-exactly-once form is the guard that matters.
